_comment: Review-only final graph literals, not import/transaction syntax. Eight definitions and four owned declarations. Type, BeadType and LinkType affiliate with BeadType; ConformsTo affiliates with LinkType. Shared exact bootstrap publication/trusted initialization is selected; these IDs/revisions remain illustrative placeholders, not production values. Prior exact intrinsic versions are retained on upgrade. No implicit affiliation edges. ConformsTo allows same/cross registered exact definition endpoints using either-Scope pairs, preserves exact metatype selectors, and is acyclic over exact revisions. Explicit T@2 conformsTo T@1 is allowed; generic identity-based acyclicity is deliberately absent. The fixture carries reachable application schemas and standard meta-schema copies for explicit-dialect roots; its two omitted-dialect roots carry no standard copies. Effective baseline meta-schema provisioning remains an explicit open decision, so these finite literals do not prove a uniform admission closure. Standard copies come from jsonschema-specifications and retain published IDs/content. Validation performs no network fetch.

propertiesSchema.title: Common Type descriptor properties
propertiesSchema.$comment: Review candidate. This is the properties schema of Type and therefore the common descriptor schema. Affiliation with BeadType or LinkType supplies category-specific validation. Shape validation is not Type admission.

Embedded JSON Schema, not a URL. Root-only dialect shape check; every schema resource in the retained closure must use the standard 2020-12 dialect. Resource discovery and closure admission are separate checks, not a scan of literal data keys. Custom extension presentation remains open.

schemaResources.$comment: Candidate retrieval-URI to exact schema-resource map, immutable with Type revision. Values retain standard $id/base/anchor semantics. Complete closure, conflicting bindings and offline resolution require admission checks.

version.$comment: Optional proposed author release label. No inferred conformance, revision matching or upgrade. Publication uniqueness remains open.

typeSelector.$comment: Candidate selector syntax. Pinned entries match exact affiliation/conformance; unpinned entries match any revision of the identity or conformance to such a revision, never latest lookup. any:true imposes no Type restriction.

participationConstraint.$comment: Candidate Bead participation rule: min omitted means zero; max omitted means unbounded. min<=max and intersection with inherited/Link bounds need semantic validation.

endpointConstraint.$comment: Candidate endpoint syntax. Scope conditions remain binding. Typed cross/either Bead arms can match registered exact Type-definition endpoints using retained accepted facts; arbitrary external resources remain opaque and cannot establish a specific Type. Registration/exact-state admission is semantic, not proved by this shape schema. resource admits an opaque external URI and does not enable local Link endpoints. Scope classification and floating external-definition resolution remain to specify.

linkConstraints.$comment: Arity, ordered-pair uniqueness and directed acyclicity apply to the combined family, not separately to pair alternatives. False/omission adds no local restriction; cannot disable inherited restrictions. No Link minimum or endpoint pin-mode field.
